config.label: API key from the signup tool or POST /v1/signup
config.description: API key from the signup tool or POST /v1/signup. Without it, the signup tool makes an account and saves the key in ~/.config/mxgate/config.json.

config.label: Only for setup_domain on a Cloudflare zone: a token with DNS edit rights
config.description: Only for setup_domain on a Cloudflare zone: a token with DNS edit rights. It stays on this machine. Vercel uses VERCEL_TOKEN; Porkbun uses PORKBUN_API_KEY and PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY.
